intelligence.enrichment: Moons are natural satellites of planets, and Earth's Moon is Earth's natural satellite; it is smaller than planets, revolves around Earth, has hardly any atmosphere, and is Earth's nearest neighbour in space. Because the Moon moves around Earth as a natural body, it is classified as a natural satellite rather than as a planet or a spacecraft. The learner correctly applies this rule: Moons are natural satellites of planets, and Earth's Moon is Earth's natural satellite; it is smaller than planets, revolves around Earth, has hardly any atmosphere, and is Earth's nearest neighbour in space. Satellite means any machine sent into space, so the Moon cannot be a satellite.
